title: Cannabis Prohibition: The Longest Lockdown. Social Isolation Is Harmful For Everyone

content_html_sanitized:
One of the most important debates about the COVID pandemic isn’t about the virus or the vaccine, but about the Lockdowns that were supposed to slow the spread of the disease. There seems to be a consensus that they were very harmful, whether or not they were necessary or effective.

 

A recent study published by the National Library of Medicine, The Causal Effect of Social Isolation on Cannabis Use Disorder and the Mediating Role of Depression, shows that social isolation has negative effects on cannabis users.

 

The politicized resistance to licensing social venues where cannabis can be used with others has been absurdly successful. A Florida politician has proposed a bill that would only allow medical cannabis users to smoke at home. It isn’t clear whether you would have to be in an actual closet, with or without the door closed.

 

In fact, this study draws a connection between social isolation and “Cannabis Use Disorder.”

 

The “analysis revealed a significant positive correlation between social isolation and increased CUD risk.

 

“Sensitivity analyses confirmed the robustness of findings. In addition, the mediation MR analysis revealed that depression significantly mediated the causal effect of social isolation on CUD.

 

“Specifically, social isolation showed a significant positive association with depression risk, and depression, in turn, was positively associated with an increased risk of CUD.

 

Conclusions: Social isolation is potentially associated with an increased risk of CUD, with depression as a key mediator.”

 

In short, this is another example of a problem caused by prohibition that is used by Prohibitionists to justify state violence against the people that they claim they are trying to help.

 

It may be that the most important things in the Dutch CoffeeShops are the tables and chairs, where cannabis aficionados can share their experiences with their friends and neighbors, and total strangers.

 

Cannabis is a “Social Drug” like alcohol, and drinking alone is seen as a risk factor for alcoholism. Now recall the theme song for the long running television comedy Cheers: “Where everybody knows your name.”
